hotels.title: Tweed Coast Glamour: Kingscliff Beachside Escape with Lagoon Pool & Daily Breakfast
hotels.description: A seaside stay at this Northern NSW gem is the perfect way to uncover the region's coastal charm without the Gold Coast crowds. Tucked away in Salt Village on the Tweed Coast, just 45 minutes from Byron Bay, this laidback retreat sits moments from South Kingscliff Beach, where calm waters and soft sands meet a slower pace. The property features a lagoon-style pool, a wading pool for little explorers, BBQ facilities and two tennis courts, so everyone can find their bliss here. Surge Restaurant & Bar offers a relaxed dining atmosphere, while The Spa at Salt is on hand for tension-melting massages in between pool and beach days. Venture out to discover Byron Bay's iconic lighthouse or discover quieter stretches of sand at Casuarina Beach, just four minutes away. Grab complimentary bikes and cycle the coastal paths, or simply claim a spot by the lagoon pool and let the days drift by. With Salt Village's shops and eateries on your doorstep and the beach just steps away, everything you need is within reach.
